_readme: Copy to /etc/contactsheet/oidc-providers.json, keep only the providers you want, chmod 640, set OIDC_PROVIDERS_FILE to it. Keys starting with _ are comments. Full reference: the project wiki, 'Provider configuration'. Redirect URI to register with each provider: <PUBLIC_ORIGIN>/images/oidc/<id>/callback

providers._about: authentik, Keycloak, Authelia, Pocket ID, Zitadel... any OpenID Connect provider works the same way.
providers.label: Sign in with authentik

providers._about: Google. Anyone with a Google account can reach this button, so either keep autoCreate off (link accounts with scripts/setemail.js) or restrict it as below.
GitHub is plain OAuth2, not OIDC; the preset fills in its endpoints and reads the verified address from /user/emails.
